edges.reason: msg.sender is used to index balances and debited in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key used to reduce allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership.
msg.sender becomes the initial owner in the constructor.
Recipient address to is used as the balance mapping key credited in transfer.
tokens amount is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
tokens amount is added to the recipient balance in transfer.
spender parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter becomes the allowance value in approve.
from parameter indexes balances and allowed for the subtraction in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited with tokens in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter is the target address of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded into the external callback.
tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external ERC20 transfer call.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
balances mapping value feeds the SafeMath subtraction in transfer.
balances mapping value feeds the SafeMath addition in transfer.
allowed mapping value feeds the SafeMath subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed mapping state is reused when crediting the recipient in transferFrom.
_totalSupply value feeds the SafeMath subtraction in totalSupply.
transfer writes updated balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes updated balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the allowed mapping.
approve writes the new allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the new allowance before making the external call.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor computes and assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged access.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply performs the SafeMath subtraction that must not underflow.
totalSupply reads the balances mapping for address(0).
transfer executes the SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance.
transfer executes the SafeMath addition on the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes the SafeMath subtraction on balance and allowance.
transferFrom executes the SafeMath addition on the recipient balance.
approveAndCall unconditionally executes the external receiveApproval call after updating allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner require check.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner require check.
The external receiveApproval call can call back into approveAndCall before it returns.
The external callback can reenter transferFrom and consume the freshly granted allowance.
The external ERC20 transfer call can reenter transferAnyERC20Token before completion.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter has no standalone security meaning and is fully bound to the transfer function's balance update.
Transferred amount flows directly into the SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance.
Spender parameter only serves as the allowance mapping key written by approve.
Allowance amount parameter is stored directly by approve.
Debited address parameter directly indexes the balances and allowed subtractions.
Credited address parameter directly receives the SafeMath addition.
Amount parameter drives the subtraction of balance and allowance in transferFrom.
Queried address parameter is only used as the balanceOf mapping key.
Allowance owner parameter is only used as an allowed mapping key.
Allowance spender parameter is only used as an allowed mapping key.
Spender parameter becomes the external call target and thus part of the untrusted call site.
Amount parameter is forwarded straight into the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded into the external callback.
Pending owner parameter is only stored by transferOwnership.
Arbitrary token address parameter is the target of the external call.
Amount parameter is forwarded directly into the external ERC20 transfer call.
